title.en: Giving Up a Seat on the MRT

subtitle: 全民英檢初級：看圖寫一段捷運讓座的短文
task: Look at the three pictures. Picture 1: A girl gets on a crowded MRT train and finds a seat. Picture 2: At the next station, an old man with a cane gets on. Picture 3: The girl stands up and gives him her seat, and he smiles. Write a paragraph of about 50 words describing what happened. Make sure your paragraph covers all three pictures.
taskZh: 請看三張圖（以文字描述）。圖一：女孩搭上擁擠的捷運，找到一個座位。圖二：下一站，一位拄拐杖的老先生上車。圖三：女孩站起來讓座，老先生微笑。請寫一段約 50 字的英文短文，描述發生了什麼事，三張圖的內容都要寫到。
focus: 內容：三張圖的重點（搭車、老先生上車、讓座）都要寫到
文法：句子完整，時態正確（敘述已發生的事用過去式）
用字與拼字：用簡單、正確的字詞，拼字無誤
大小寫與標點：句首、人名、地名大寫，句尾標點正確

en: Last Sunday, Amy took the MRT to visit her aunt. The train was very crowded, but she found an empty seat. At the next station, an old man with a cane got on the train. He looked tired and could not find a seat. Amy stood up right away and gave her seat to him. The old man smiled and thanked her. Amy felt happy all day.
zh: 上週日，Amy 搭捷運去看她的阿姨。車廂非常擁擠，但她找到一個空位。到了下一站，一位拄著拐杖的老先生上了車。他看起來很累，也找不到座位。Amy 馬上站起來，把座位讓給他。老先生微笑著向她道謝。Amy 一整天都很開心。

patterns.zh: 用 but 連接兩件相反的事
patterns.example: The train was very crowded, but she found an empty seat.
He looked tired and could not find a seat.
Amy stood up right away and gave her seat to him.
